content:
Beloved Nefertiti,  
Radiant Lady of Beauty and Grace,  
She whose name means “The Beautiful One Has Come,”  
I turn my heart and thoughts toward you.

Nefertiti, royal woman of the Two Lands,  
Crowned in your tall blue headdress,  
Companion of kings and mother of daughters,  
Symbol of strength, dignity, and timeless beauty—  
I honor you.

May your calm gaze teach me inner poise,  
May your regal bearing awaken my self‑respect,  
May your unshakable presence help me to stand tall  
In the face of doubt, fear, and hardship.

You who walked among temples and sunlight,  
Who knew both power and responsibility,  
Guide me to carry my own power wisely:  
To speak with honesty,  
To act with compassion,  
To balance heart and mind.

Let your beauty remind me  
That true radiance begins within—  
In kindness, in courage, in quiet confidence.  
Help me see my own worth,  
And the worth of every soul I meet.

Beloved Nefertiti,  
Stand beside me in my daily life:  
Bless my home with harmony,  
My relationships with respect and tenderness,  
My work with purpose and integrity.

May I honor you by honoring myself,  
By walking with elegance,  
By choosing what is noble and just,  
By creating beauty where I can.

I offer you my love, my remembrance, and my gratitude.  
May your name be spoken in peace,  
Your image shine in my heart,  
Now and always.

So may it be.
